items.title: Cars: a garage for every car
items.text: Add your cars with a photo (from Glint or your camera) and decide who else can see each one. Dates, fuel and service history are coming next.

items.title: Car dates that remind you
items.text: Add MOT, tax, insurance and service dates to a car. Roost nudges your phone 30 days and 7 days before, and on the day, and Renewed moves the date on for next year.

items.title: Fuel and running costs per car
items.text: Log a fill-up in seconds and Roost works out miles per gallon, what each mile costs and this month's spend. Add service, parking, tyres and other costs too. No signal at the pump? It saves on your phone and sends later.

items.title: Service history and receipts for each car
items.text: Log services, repairs and MOTs with the garage, mileage and what was done, and keep the receipt: it is saved into your Nest under Cars. Print or export the history when you sell. Documents like the V5C live under Papers.

items.title: Charts for your car
items.text: See what each month cost split by fuel, service, insurance and the rest, how your miles per gallon move tank by tank, and where the last year went. Tap a bar for the numbers.

items.title: Cockerel picks his own brain
items.text: For each message he chooses Haiku, Sonnet or Opus, whichever is cheapest and still good enough, and says which in a small tag. Tap Think harder to use the strongest model for one message, or pin one in Admin.

items.title: A smarter, better-remembering Cockerel
items.text: He keeps the thread of a long chat, reads text files you drop in his Nest folder, knows what you are watching, does sums properly, learns routines, holds small notes for the morning in quiet hours, and double-checks risky actions. Tap Not right when he gets one wrong.
